lines.text: A flying angel proclaims the eternal gospel and says to fear God, because the hour of His judgment has come.
Babylon falls, and a third angel warns that those with the beast's mark drink the wine of God's mercy.
One like the Son of Man on a white cloud holds a sharp rod and harvests the earth.
An angel gathers earth's grapes into the great winepress of God's wrath, trodden outside the city.
